description:
Make the pipeline choose providers from the recording's resolved selection instead of ProviderKind.

- RecordingController deps.providers(kind) (controller.ts:188, services.ts:155) -> providers(optionId) returning a LiveSpeechProvider from a registry map (local toolkit, Soniox, later Speechmatics).
- controller.ts:195 liveStt "skipped" check uses the resolved selection.
- PostProcessor: replace rec.provider === "soniox" with capabilities: skip final STT when stt-final is locked by the live service (post-processor.ts:223); run the fused-service path when diarization is "fused-with-stt" (generalize fuseSoniox, post-processor.ts:342, to key on providerLabel scoping rather than the Soniox name). Final STT dispatches to a cloud batch provider when stt-final is a cloud option (interface only here; implementations in the batch tickets).
- ModelWarmup (services.ts ModelWarmup) doesn't load local models for locked roles (e.g. no VAD/Moonshine warm-up when Soniox is live).
- Old recordings with provider "soniox" and no resolved snapshot map to the Soniox rules so reprocessing still works (RecordingView.tsx:223 re-transcribe offer).

Done when: pipeline tests cover local, Soniox-live, and a fake cloud-final provider; existing Soniox recordings reprocess unchanged.
title: Pipeline: dispatch live and final providers from the resolved selection
